newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa approves increased overseas money orders.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa approves increased overseas money orders.

text.p: The South African Post Office said on Monday that residents were now able to send up to 2,000 rand a month in money orders to beneficiaries in foreign countries without prior approval.
The Reserve Bank approved the increase from the previous limit of 200 rand as part of the ongoing relaxation of exchange controls.
